title: Time Test steps from job logs when GitHub returns no steps
body:
Outcome: the shard wall report times every Test job whose `Run test shard` step appears in its job log, even when GitHub's jobs API returns that job with steps: [], so a window can print 'target < 18 s: PASS' instead of INCOMPLETE.
Evidence: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f at d2a2baf printed 'runs: 5 of 5 wanted since e9ebc8f, 22 of 50 Test steps untimed'; t-xp4a97f saw 15 and 25 of 50 untimed minutes apart for the same runs. slowestVerdict in scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs returns INCOMPLETE whenever any step is untimed, so the t-wm22s14 window (close condition 'target < 18 s: PASS') can pass only by luck. fetchShardRuns already downloads each Test job's raw log for KRN_TEST_SUMMARY_JSON, and every log line carries a timestamp; the step starts at its '##[group]Run' line, and the next '##[group]Run' or 'Post job cleanup' line ends it.
Acceptance: testStepSeconds falls back to the step's span in the job log when the API step lacks timing. It is tested against a verbatim captured Test job log (KRN-12), and its seconds match the API step timing within 1 s on jobs that carry both. node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f reports untimed only for jobs whose log lacks the step.
